notes: NEW Two (or more) of the same instrument playing together: press the + on a track, or use 'Add another line of this sound' (track menu, Track panel). The new line keeps the instrument, knobs and effects and gets its own volume, pan and mixer strip
Loops panel: turn on 'New line each time' (or hold Shift while clicking +) to put every loop on a fresh line of the selected track's sound
Fix: the loop list can no longer try to draw every loop at once when its panel is collapsed
